title: The Return of Lata: Building an Authentic Polynesian Voyaging Canoe
lineage: Inspected the cited passages; the retained file is a paraphrased research note.

passages.note: Project account describes a separately named Te Puke, Vaka Taumako, launched 12 September 1997, with outrigger and reversible sailing; it does not establish that Parangaina is that vessel.
